textSnippet: from numpy import array def saisie(): n = int(input("n= ")) while n % 2 != 0: n = int(input("n= ")) return n def remplire_mat(n, m): x = 1 for i in range(n // 2): cf = n - 1 - i for j in range(i, cf + 1): m[i, j] = x x = x + 1 for k in range(i + 1, cf + 1): m[k, cf] = x x = x + 1 for l in range(cf - 1, i - 1, -1): m[cf, l] = x x = x + 1
